features: ULTRA SLIM DESIGN SMARTWATCH - Experience the ultra slim smartwatch crafted for modern lifestyles—lightweight, sleek, and stylish design that offers all-day comfort. The slimmest AMOLED smartwatch blends elegance with performance, perfect for men & women.

AMOLED DISPLAY SMARTWATCH WITH ALWAYS-ON DISPLAY (466x466 RESOLUTION) - Enjoy a stunning 1.43” AMOLED display smartwatch with 466x466 high resolution and Always-On Display, delivering crystal-clear visuals, vibrant colors, and sharp clarity even in bright sunlight.

ALL-IN-ONE HEALTH TRACKING – Stay effortlessly in tune with your body through comprehensive tracking of heart rate, SpO2, sleep, and daily activity, delivering real-time insights that help you understand, improve, and take control of your overall wellness.
BLUETOOTH CALLING SMARTWATCH - Stay connected anytime with Bluetooth calling smartwatch, featuring a built-in mic & speaker to make and receive calls directly from your wrist.
DESIGNED FOR COMFORT & EVERYDAY WEAR - The slim, lightweight construction ensures a comfortable fit throughout the day, making Phoenix Nova ideal for work, social settings and daily use.
description: Fire-Boltt Legacy Nova Slim Smart Watch with 1.43” AMOLED Display, Bluetooth Calling, Always On Display, Ultra-Slim Design, Voice Assistant, Smart Notifications, IP68 Waterproof Midnight Black
